name: Wied il-Għasri
description: A narrow inlet cut into the north Gozo cliffs, ending in a pebble beach about ten metres wide with vertical rock either side. Snorkelling here is the best on the islands. In any swell it's dangerous and it closes itself.
getting: Park at the top of the valley road near Għasri and take the stone steps down. There is no bus stop and no shade at the bottom.
